title: Snoozing alerts via wear does not dismiss the notification on the phone if done too quickly
body:
Swiping to snooze the alert toast message on a smartwatch that is used as the primary collector does not dismiss the notification on the phone if the alert triggering reading has not yet been synced to the phone yet. This happens if when snoozing on the wear too quickly, the phone notification then needs to be nsoozed independatly creating a double requirement to snooze both alerts as they are then in effect forked.

This could be fixed by sending a secondary push to the phone to snooze an alert after a delay that matches the data sync cycle.
